svg.text: 3 bedrooms / 3 baths / 2,400 sq ft gross enclosed / Kitchen and pantry revision
COOKING: 36" induction hob + 30" built-in oven below + 36" hood above.
STORAGE: drawer bases, waste pullout, six fitted pantry shelf bays below high windows, and pantry worktop.
EQUIPMENT: 48" panel-ready fridge, sink and dishwasher. Other rooms remain schematic.
Concept only. Includes walls; excludes courtyard, garden and roof overhangs. Dimensions govern; do not scale.
